name: usage-statusbar
description: A slim colored line above the prompt with your real usage: subscription windows, org spend limits, budgets, context and cost

display.title: Display
display.description: band: colored line above the prompt. status: plain-text status line. both: the two together.

style.title: Style
style.description: How the band looks. Calm gauges stay small in every style; a gauge near its limit gets a full bar, a note and its reset time. pulse: animated bars on the desktop, with a live dot while a turn runs. chips: each gauge is a pill filled to its percentage, amber or red near a limit. ledger: each gauge is a column with its own thin bar directly beneath it. /usagebar style <name> switches it.

show_5h.title: Show 5-hour window
show_5h.description: The 5-hour subscription window. Off hides it from the bar; the /usagebar pane still shows it.

show_7d.title: Show 7-day window
show_7d.description: The 7-day subscription window. Off hides it from the bar; the /usagebar pane still shows it.

show_spend.title: Show spend cap
show_spend.description: The org cap or personal budget gauge. Off hides it from the bar; the /usagebar pane still shows it.

show_today.title: Show today and month spend
show_today.description: Spend today, and this month when no cap is set (API pricing). Off hides it from the bar; the /usagebar pane still shows it.

show_session.title: Show session cost
show_session.description: What this session has cost. Off hides it from the bar; the /usagebar pane still shows it.

show_context.title: Show context
show_context.description: How full the context window is. Off hides it from the bar; the /usagebar pane still shows it.

show_cache.title: Show cache countdown
show_cache.description: A countdown to when the prompt cache lapses, kept per model. Amber near the end, red once it has lapsed, after a model switch or after a compaction, with what the next turn will cost to re-read. Appears after the first reply.

cache_ttl.title: Cache lifetime
cache_ttl.description: How long the prompt cache lasts after a reply. auto works it out the way Claude Code does: 1 hour on a subscription within its plan usage, 5 minutes on an API key, a provider or once usage credits are billing, with CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H and the promptCacheTtl setting honoured. 5m or 1h forces it.

cache_write_usd_per_mtok.title: Cache write price (USD per million tokens)
cache_write_usd_per_mtok.description: Used to estimate what the next turn costs once the cache has lapsed. Set it to your model's cache-write price; 0 hides the estimate.

budget_usd.title: Personal budget (USD)
budget_usd.description: Your own spending limit, tracked from Claude Code's cost on this machine. 0 turns it off.

budget_period.title: Budget period
budget_period.description: How often the personal budget resets.

org_limit_usd.title: Monthly spend cap (USD)
org_limit_usd.description: Your org's monthly spend cap in dollars. With a gateway that enforces it, converts the gateway's percentage to dollars; without one, it's compared with Claude Code's spend on this machine. 0 turns it off.

admin_api_key.title: Admin API key
admin_api_key.description: Optional sk-ant-admin key. Reads your org's real spend and spend limits from the Anthropic Admin API. ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY in the environment works too.

admin_user.title: Admin API user
admin_user.description: Claude Enterprise: your user ID (user_...) or email, to read your own effective spend limit. Leave empty on a Console org to read the org or workspace limit.

admin_workspace_id.title: Admin API workspace
admin_workspace_id.description: Console orgs: the workspace ID (wrkspc_...) whose limit and spend to show. Empty uses the organization's limit.

admin_poll_minutes.title: Admin API refresh (minutes)
admin_poll_minutes.description: How often to re-read spend from the Admin API.
